title: Choose the visual world
question: The build is the Build Book. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Build Book
options.lineage: a brick build-instruction book, fused with this portfolio
options.thesis: Your portfolio as an assembly manual: every project is a numbered step that snaps together on screen.
options.viewport: A cover spread: builder portrait, name in oversized step numerals, one red brick snapping down onto the stud grid — the proof of the build in the first second.
options.risk: Loses its voice if the assembly becomes literal toy decoration instead of a working interaction.

options.label: Jakarta Night-Market Neon
options.lineage: the glow of Jakarta's roadside signboards at night
options.thesis: A sign that stays open 24/7: your work as panels of living neon over rain-slick asphalt.
options.case: The roll's pick — unmistakably Indonesian and fun, but a sign sells the design half only, and flicker brushes your gimmick pet-peeve.
options.viewport: A dark street at night: your portrait as a sign face, each letter igniting in sequence.
options.risk: Neon is the creative-studio cliché; it survives only by staying Jakarta-specific, not generic signage.

options.label: CD-ROM Console
options.lineage: a mid-nineties CD-ROM interface, a rendered machine
options.thesis: The whole screen a machine with a small window playing you; navigation is pressing toggles that visibly depress.
options.case: Fuses well — the console maps to the lab and the window to the portrait — but the chrome risks reading as gimmick, your stated pet-peeve.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.lineage: a CRT oscilloscope on a signal bench
options.thesis: Your outputs as traces on phosphor over an etched graticule: devs identify instantly, the grid is the system.
options.case: Fuses cleanly — front-end work is literally signals — but dark phosphor risks reading flat to design clients.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean single-page portfolio: hero, work grid, about, contact — executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full fidelity.
